verdict.rationale: Penpot's self-hosting model lets users choose where data physically resides (own private cloud, on-premise, any environment), which effectively satisfies data residency control, and this is corroborated by hands-on self-host reports. However, there's no explicit region-selection feature for the hosted/cloud offering itself (no multi-region cloud options), and no formal data-residency/compliance documentation. missing for 10: explicit region-selection UI/config for cloud-hosted Penpot, formal data residency/compliance certifications (e.g., GDPR region guarantees), independent verification of self-host data-locality claims beyond docs.
